rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a recreational hike, especially one on hills or trails.

example.english: We are going on a hike on Sunday.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this for a hike or outing understood as a longer walk, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: The school is arranging a hike for students next month.
example.traditional: 學校下個月安排學生遠足。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 jyut6 on1 paai4 hok6 saang1 jyun5 zuk1

rows.note: Use this for the amount or rate of an abrupt increase, such as a rent hike.

example.english: This rent hike is really outrageous.
example.traditional: 呢次租金加幅真係太誇張。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 zou1 gam1 gaa1 fuk1 zan1 hai6 taai3 kwaa1 zoeng1
